_comment: Study 6 on-ledger fixture ids (LUKSO mainnet, chain 42). The three products are batteries (keys lmt, industrial, stationary; product data in fixtures/study6-batteries.json), created on the platform in the Oskvale workspace by fixtures/create-study6-mainnet.ts, which recorded productId, variantId and batchId (gtin fixed in advance, GS1 952 demonstration prefix). 22 Oct 2026: James tokenised each batch with the UP browser extension and Synced each product, completing every signing (an abandoned Sync makes the public check report 'changed after signing', a known defect). The coordinator checked each on the mainnet explorer (symbol RWA, supply 1, keccak256(UPI) == tokenId) and the platform verify endpoint (verified), and recorded collection, tokenId, upi and mintTx here; the holder of all three is the Oskvale organisation profile (organisation.profileAddress), which the declaration file names as its account. The public profile is named 'Oskvale'; the explorer shows no profile name for it. tokenId = the item's bytes32 token id, 0x + 64 hex. stimulus/build-study6.ts refuses counted stimuli while any id here is null or the network is not LUKSO mainnet 42; --mock uses the TESTNET Study 2-5 collections A/B/C (stimulus/study6.ts MOCK_FIXTURES), purely to exercise the pipeline. The upi values name a platform host and are recorded for the record only: no stimulus links them.
